gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: --- Part 1: Semaphore with a negative limit survives shutdown and remains queryable ---
ADDED i2: Use a large thread pool and MINUTES period so the background timer never fires during the (mocked) test, avoiding race conditions on acquireCount.
ADDED i3: Manually trigger end-of-period (resets acquireCount and wakes waiting threads)
ADDED i4: First shutdown cancels the periodic task and marks the semaphore as shut down
ADDED i5: Querying acquireCount after shutdown must not throw
ADDED i6: A second shutdown call on an already-shut-down semaphore must be a no-op
ADDED i7: Querying the limit after shutdown must not throw
ADDED i8: Verify that Builder can be instantiated (no configuration applied here)
ADDED i9: --- Part 2: Constructing a TimedSemaphore with a non-positive period is illegal ---
ADDED i10: A period of -1 violates the "must be greater than 0" contract
